detail:
Full summary: Wave C core implemented (TDD, uncommitted->committing now, unreleased): relation upsert-dedup both backends, declared/derived origin marker, populator per-step isolation + dead related_to removal, lineage on twining_why. 1608 tests green, build clean.
Decisions: Chose relation upsert by (source, target, type) with last-wins property merge in BOTH backends, mirroring addEntity's name+type upsert — append-only relations duplicated decided_by edges on every re-record and made any derivation pass non-idempotent; same-pair different-type stays distinct; sqlite parity is contractual; Chose properties.origin declared|derived (absent = legacy/unknown) following the shipped rationale_source/origin precedents — tool-handler stamps declared with caller-supplied origin winning by spread order; all 14 auto-populator edges stamp derived; sequenced BEFORE any future derivation per the D13 ordering constraint; Chose to REMOVE onPost's speculative relates_to loop rather than repair it — it targeted blackboard entry ids that are never graph entities (1 coincidental edge in 2,352 live), post-to-post linking is the blackboard relates_to field's job, and the removal pin guards against the entry-id/entity-name coincidence minting bogus edges; added per-step isolation in onDecide so one NOT_FOUND edge (pre-graph or pruned concept) no longer aborts the remaining edge groups; Chose lineage as an opt-in flag on twining_why attaching lineage_head to superseded_excluded entries, with a fresh cycle-guarded depth-capped walker in DecisionEngine — left the dashboard's bulk buildSupersededChains untouched (different query shape: all-chains enumeration vs targeted head resolution); deviates from the disposition's lift-and-share phrasing deliberately
Findings: Wave C REMAINING before release: (1) the amend-candidates housekeeping reporter (re-scoped D13 ask 1: enumerate files under an empty-affected_files decision's scope, rank by term overlap with summary+rationale, report-only, twining_amend as write path — land beside entity-scope-repair.ts with caps + truncation notes); (2) adversarial review workflow on the full Wave C diff (mandatory here — both prior waves' reviews caught majors); (3) CHANGELOG 2.11.0 + REFERENCE/README notes for lineage + origin marker; (4) ship train: plugin 1.29.0, npm version 2.11.0, tag push, pins both scopes; The relation upsert changes NO existing test but changes field-store behavior: re-recording a decision now merges instead of duplicating decided_by edges — the 2,352-relation field graph will stop growing duplicate edges but existing duplicates remain (a dedup housekeeping pass for EXISTING duplicates was NOT built — candidate future item)
summary: Wave C core implemented (TDD, uncommitted->committing now, unreleased): relation upsert-dedup both backends, declared/derived origin marker, populator per-step isolation + dead related_to removal, …
